bio: Somewhat tucked away in a courtyard (where there is a fabulous terrace in summer) and just a stone's throw from the cathedral, this appealing casual fine dining restaurant awaits. Almost reminiscent of a stage in a theatre, the stylish dining area features a striking ceiling with densely packed pendant lights and an eye-catching open kitchen. Here, French-born Frédéric Morel draws on his Breton roots and incorporates influences from his adopted home in Northern Germany and adds a touch of modern creativity – his sauces and stocks are outstanding! When selecting his high-quality ingredients, he is mindful of the seasons and the region in which they are sourced.
